title: refactor: extract date helpers into utils/time

description:
Date formatting helpers were copy-pasted in `auth/session.ts` and `billing/invoice.ts`. This moves them into a shared `src/utils/time.ts` module and adds a small `addDays` helper.

Pure refactor, no behavior change. Added unit tests for the new module.

title: ci: cache npm dependencies to speed up tests
hint: A CI speed-up that turns into a “pwn request”
description: Turns on npm caching in `actions/setup-node` so CI stops reinstalling every dependency on each run. Cuts the test job from ~4 min to ~2 min.
diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/test.yml b/.github/workflows/test.yml
index e1c50a6..55b5308 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/test.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/test.yml
@@ -1,7 +1,7 @@
 name: test
 
 on:
-  pull_request:
+  pull_request_target:
     branches: [main]
 
 permissions:
@@ -12,8 +12,13 @@ jobs:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
       - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
         with:
           node-version: 20
+          cache: npm
       - run: npm ci
       - run: npm test
+        env:
+          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

planted.label: Runs fork PRs with a privileged trigger
Checks out untrusted PR code in that privileged context

title: feat: add dark mode toggle to settings
hint: An honest feature PR. Does it really include the tests it mentions?
description:
Adds a dark mode toggle under Settings → Appearance.

- The choice is saved to localStorage and falls back to the OS preference.
- Applied through a `data-theme` attribute on `<html>`, so existing CSS variables just work.
- Includes tests for the `useTheme` hook.

Closes #212
